about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.

4abba57.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. index.html plus the three js/ files that put a pixel on screen: js/10_assets.js makes the textures, js/20_level.js the lit materials, js/40_render.js is the rasterizer. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire, blob by blob, against the deployed page.

shots.note: RE-TAKEN from the DEPLOYED page for #844 at build 0546b82. The previous pass bound 12a7825; since then #807 merged the wrapped-finger hand (the support hand’s finger prisms now stop short of the part they hold, so at the hip the pump, magazine and cylinder read between the fingers), #859 gave ABATOIR CORE a dealt arrival bearing of its own, and #353 put someone on every authored overlook - so recap labelled the 12a7825 rows FRAME-STALE and the front page was describing a hand the deployed game no longer draws. This pass is the same eight poses re-run against the deploy, which serves main’s bytes: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs served by that URL sha256-match this checkout, twelve for twelve, proved before the shutter. Route: tools/livecap.js devRoute against the DEPLOYED page - one page load and one boot per pose at ?dev=1&seed=60&boot=0, DEV.freeze(true), DEV.set("grain",0), DEV.clear() before the pose, shutter from the canvas after DEV.tick. The display surface was pinned with Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride to 1440x763 (this chromium build reports innerHeight 620 for every --window-size tried, and every frame in docs/screens is 1440x763), so the raster and the aspect are the ones the committed frames have always carried. Chromium gave RGBA; committed through tools/png_rgb.js. Every seat, layout and audio term below was read back out of the page that drew the frame, and every mean re-measured from these bytes with tools/recap.js’s own decoder. Pose: the spawn seat, then DEV.clear() and DEV.spawn('grunt', 1, 6); the route’s own seat search needed no turn and left him at (11.10, 4.53), 6.00 m out on the view line, on a floorAt 0.00 band with 255 raster px of him painted. Layout signature 4083630493 for this sector under seed 60 on this instrument. Audio term: SND.ac.sampleRate read 44100 in the page that drew this frame, so this seed deals this layout after 66150 seeded draws through SND.init’s noise buffer (#404); the rows these frames replace state 48000 and 72,000 draws, so
